blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The city government of Iligan is moving to modernize its solid waste management system through a proposed 23-hectare integrated “circular economy” facility aimed at reducing landfill waste, boosting recycling, and converting organic discards into useful resources. The initiative took a step forward on Tuesday with the signing of a memorandum of agreement between the Iligan City government and the European Union (EU), represented by Ambassador to the Philippines Massimo Santoro. The event was attended by officials from the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Center of the Philippines, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Region 10, and the EU-PH Green […]...
